generation_context.presentation_context: high-end executive review in a conference room

triggers: collapsed reading path or unusable layout

style_lock.name: deck-style-v1
style_lock.font_style: Noto Sans CJK SC / clean sans-serif
style_lock.surface: light paper with restrained card depth
style_lock.icon_style: flat business icons with consistent stroke weight
style_lock.grid: 12-column editorial grid with stable title baseline and generous outer margins
style_lock.shared_chrome: same title zone, footer conclusion treatment, page number position and component rhythm across the deck
style_lock.material_language: premium editorial paper, controlled depth, fine linework and restrained light; no glossy app-dashboard treatment

quality_target.visual_language: high-end executive editorial information design; luxurious through hierarchy, material depth and restraint
must_have: one unambiguous focal point per page
stable deck-wide grid, title baseline, footer and component rhythm
controlled material texture, depth and light rather than decoration for decoration
semantic visuals that explain the relationship instead of a wall of equal cards
avoid_items: micro-copy wall or unapproved English labels
fake charts, fake metrics, watermarks or stock-style clutter

generation_session.shared_preamble: Use the same model, same conversation context, same deck style lock and same visual anchor for every page; vary only the page-specific narrative framework.

slides.title: verbatim slide title
slides.core_logic: one sentence explaining the relationship on the page
slides.visual_generation_prompt: Visual-only description of the composition, hierarchy, surfaces, light and visual flow; do not use this field alone for generation.
slides.closure_treatment: Decide whether the conclusion is inline, integrated into the framework, in a side rail, a compact callout, or not a separate visual element; do not assume a full-width bottom banner.
detailed_content_paragraphs: First reserve paragraph: summarize the situation and the decision this page must support using only traceable source material.
Second reserve paragraph: decompose the proposed actions, roles or stages into a coherent relationship for the visual framework.
Third reserve paragraph: state the expected outcome, constraints and risk controls without inventing data.

layout_blueprint.focal_point: the one visual anchor that must dominate the page
layout_blueprint.reading_path: header → central framework → supporting modules → conclusion

zones.name: conclusion
zones.purpose: close the page according to its semantic role
zones.content_capacity: one concise conclusion or action close; not necessarily a banner

anti_template_rules: do not use unrelated equal cards
do not leave the central framework unconnected

rules: Use inline color emphasis for approved keywords without changing or adding copy.
Keep the bottom conclusion sentence on one line where possible; do not flatten mapped keywords to the body color.

diagram_annotations.purpose: name a relationship inside the visual framework

slides.production_prompt: A self-contained 16:9 presentation-slide prompt. Use #14313B, #287B80, #E85B47 and #F7F0E4. Render every item in the 页面文字 section verbatim, do not invent data, do not use SVG/HTML/Canvas or code to add text, and use an asymmetric editorial information landscape with one dominant visual anchor, clear hierarchy and generous whitespace; never fall back to a generic card wall.
